clock_boundary: All scheduled outcomes from the distinct q8/q13/q21/q34 clock control are retained; these are not extra q55/q89/q144 manifold samples.

interpretation.decision_scope: Descriptive comparison of three retained finite levels, not statistical rejection of convergence.

future_uncertainty_contract.bounded_control: Fix one region and one scalar statistic before drawing; validate on an exactly enumerable order.
future_uncertainty_contract.comparison: Include sampled-reference uncertainty, cross-level coupling if any and multiplicity for the chosen decision family.
future_uncertainty_contract.custody: Pin the actual driver, graph construction, seeds and all outcomes; declare precision and decision thresholds before sampling.
future_uncertainty_contract.joint_chains: Retain per-draw C2/C3/C4 summands, their cross-products, sample count and sampling design.
future_uncertainty_contract.weighted_spectrum: Retain each weight and weighted value/grid indicator, or joint sufficient statistics including denominator cross-products.

interpretation.q144_chunk_parallel_driver: not_retained; neighbour digest and recorded q21/q34 identities only
